component.name: Lithnode
component.summary: Draw a team of coding agents and run it

description.p: Lithnode runs teams of coding-agent sessions (Claude Code, Codex and Cursor) as a graph you draw. Give each team a job, its command-line tools and connectors, split big jobs across agents, and have others check the work.
Every agent runs on your own sign-in and plan. Lithnode is free and never charges you.

ul.li: Start programs on your system (org.freedesktop.Flatpak): runs claude, codex, cursor-agent, git and the command-line tools you allow, outside the sandbox, in the folder you pick. That is the app's whole job, and it is why your app store says "Arbitrary permissions".
Home folder: reads the project folders you pick and keeps Lithnode's own data in ~/.lithnode.
Display and graphics: draws the window.
No network access: Lithnode itself never goes online.

description.p: Rather not grant this? Run it from source instead: it is plain Python, and every line is on GitHub.
